newsitem.title: INDIA: India rickshaw driver returns $25,000 to tourists.
newsitem.headline: India rickshaw driver returns $25,000 to tourists.

text.p: A motorised rickshaw driver in eastern India returned $25,000 to a pair of tourists after he found the money lying on the back seat of his vehicle, the Press Trust of India said on Tuesday.
The news agency said driver Swapan Dey discovered the money after he took two West Indian tourists on a sightseeing tour of Lalbagh town in the state of West Bengal, and promptly returned the cash.
It quoted Lalbagh police as saying Dey would be rewarded for his honesty, but gave no other details.
